<CLT=cltSYSTEM>From here on out, <CLT=cltSTRONG>blue-colored weak spots<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
will appear.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If we call the weak spots you've seen up until now
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Argue Points<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Then these <CLT=cltSTRONG>blue-colored weak spots<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
will be called <CLT=cltSTRONG>Agree Points<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When shooting <CLT=cltSTRONG>Agree Points<CLT=cltSYSTEM> with Truth Bullets,
you need to <CLT=cltSTRONG>flip your way of thinking<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Instead of arguing that the other person's testimony
contains <CLT=cltSTRONG>lies or mistakes<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Please fire the Truth Bullets that prove the other
person's testimony is <CLT=cltSTRONG>correct<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When your Truth Bullets merge
with their statement...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>They will complement each other,
resulting in a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Consent<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>From now on, you must <CLT=cltSTRONG>infer<CLT=cltSYSTEM> whether it's best to
"argue" or "agree" based on what's being debated.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can also <CLT=cltSTRONG>V Consent<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, so if
you're confident, give that a shot.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Thank you for your time.
Respectfully, SYSTEM
